title: stock_account — WIP Account Entries from mrp_account Close

key_findings.cal_price_override: mrp_account/models/mrp_production.py:57 — _cal_price sets finished goods price_unit from total_cost (components + workcenter + extra); AVCO/FIFO uses actual cost, standard uses product.standard_price
key_findings.post_labour_guard: mrp_account/models/mrp_production.py:104 — labour journal entry requires product.valuation == 'real_time' AND production_location.valuation_account_id; skipped silently if either absent
key_findings.workcenter_expense_override: mrp_account/models/mrp_workcenter.py:13 — expense_account_id on workcenter overrides product expense account for labour DR leg
key_findings.wip_wizard_auto_reversal: mrp_account/wizard/mrp_wip_accounting.py:142 — _reverse_moves posted immediately on confirm; reversal_date defaults to date+1 day; both entry and reversal carry wip_production_ids linkage
key_findings.wip_account_fields: stock_account/models/res_company.py:16-17 — account_production_wip_account_id and account_production_wip_overhead_account_id are company-level check_company fields; must be configured per company
key_findings.component_entry_direction: stock_account/models/stock_move.py:229-249 — _get_account_move_line_vals: if source location has valuation_account_id then DR stock_valuation CR location_account; else DR location_account CR stock_valuation
key_findings.should_create_guard: stock_account/models/stock_move.py:659-667 — _should_create_account_move requires is_storable, is_valued, valued location present, non-zero qty, real_time valuation
